The '''Banthan Drifts''' was an area that was located on the eastern edge oof the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The small settlement of [[Malcolm's Dunes]] was located in the Drifts, near [[Outpost Thorazan]], and the [[Bantha Drifts Tunnel]] linked the Drifts to the interior of the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]].
